assumption_statement: Sponsors will pay about 20 bps a year on average billable AUA for outsourced DAF administration while keeping legal ownership and reserved decisions.
assessment_level: 3 (revenue driver; becomes low-correctability once a multi-year contract is signed)
admissibility_result: Admissible as a hypothesis; 'useful market-led design constraint' (daf-landscape:research/commercial-opportunity/daf-servicing-20bps-market-entry-2026-11-25.md conclusion) risks premature synthesis if used as a price before any buyer evidence.
operational_test: Fails under pressure: a sponsor holding $2.7m per fund (CJP EOY) can negotiate below 20 bps (TIFIN schedule drops to 10-20 bps above $1m); a 30% market fall cuts revenue while workload stays.
supporting_evidence: TIFIN Give ADV (Mar 2025) service fee generally 30 bps to $1m, 10-20 bps above (research/commercial-opportunity/daf-servicing-20bps-market-entry-2026-11-25.md:8, secondary in repo, quality B); Renaissance Administration contractor payments $413-$745 per DAF-year ~33-37 bps at two sponsors (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/13-EVIDENCE-BACKLOG-RESULTS.md:29; 05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:103-104; Form 990 floors, quality B); RCF FY2024 audited payments to Ren $19.2255m 'under 98% of individual fundholder fees' (research/commercial-opportunity/daf-servicing-20bps-market-entry-2026-11-25.md:8).
contradictory_evidence: Software-only incumbent prices $32-$129 per DAF-year, median ~$70 (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/13-EVIDENCE-BACKLOG-RESULTS.md:26) - a $200k fund at 20 bps pays $400 [D]; sponsor asset-fee margins are large so switching pressure is low (05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:59 EV-07); board set licence prices with 'no client validation' (OD-M-11, unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/LEDGER.md 2026-11-25 row); Ren floors may bundle gift consulting/investment admin (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:103; 15-SAVINGS-CLAIMS.md:47); no public RFPs 2024-26 (research/commercial-opportunity/clarity-edf-analysis/assumption-tests.md:148); willingness to pay listed open (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/13-EVIDENCE-BACKLOG-RESULTS.md:55).
evidence_admissibility_notes: All supporting price points are incumbent disclosures with unknown scope and average-asset denominators (proximity low; verifiability medium). RCF->Ren is a related programme relationship, not an arm's-length market price (incentives of source).
hidden_assumptions: Buyer compares bps to bps rather than per-fund cost; billable base is average not year-end assets; scope equals Ren-class administration; no tiering for large funds; sponsor absorbs fee rather than passing it to donors; 20 bps clears the servicer's cost at the anchor's balance mix.
causal_mechanism: Sponsor revenue is asset-based (60/30/20/15 bps donor tiers, research/daf-economics-and-distribution-2026-11-11.md:64-68); a servicer priced in bps shares that revenue; willingness to pay is bounded by the sponsor's avoided internal staff + software cost plus the value of transferred operational risk.
alternative_explanations: Observed 33-37 bps reflects bundled services or captive/affiliated programmes rather than an open-market price for administration alone; bps pricing persists because it mirrors the sponsor's revenue unit, not because of value delivered.
incentives: Sponsor: minimise fixed cost, keep donor-fee margin. Incumbents: can price-match on large books. Servicer: bps revenue rewards asset retention, which conflicts with grant-making (daf-servicing-20bps-market-entry-2026-11-25.md research backlog item 6).
feedback_loops: Market drawdown -> lower fee revenue with unchanged workload -> pressure to cut service; price compression from incumbents -> lower margin -> less capacity for exceptions; higher payout -> lower balances -> lower revenue per unit of work.
dependencies: AC-07 average balances; AC-09 minimums; scope definition; AC-03 per-account cost.
failure_conditions: Qualified buyers' acceptable effective rate below ~15 bps for full scope; buyer insists on per-fund price below Unbound's modelled cost ($150-$299, 15-SAVINGS-CLAIMS.md:26); large-balance anchor negotiates tiers that cut effective rate below break-even.
counterfactuals: Per-fund fee ($250-$400 per fund-year [A]) independent of markets; hybrid minimum plus bps; software-only licence at $32-$129 per DAF-year band.
falsifying_evidence: Three or more of five qualified sponsor conversations reject >=15 bps for full scope; a public ADV, contract or 990 showing full-service administration below 15 bps; any observed award at lower price.
claim_state: unsupported (for this servicer); suggestive (that a 10-37 bps market exists)
correctability: Moderately correctable before signature; low correctability inside a multi-year contract
decision_posture: Experimental for price discovery; Strategic for the first multi-year contract
monitoring_signal: Effective rate accepted in discovery/pilot negotiations, by balance tier
threshold: Median acceptable effective rate <15 bps, or per-fund equivalent below fully loaded cost per fund
trigger_claim: Below ~15 bps the break-even AUA exceeds what one attainable anchor provides
trigger_reassessment: Reset if scope, cost base or average-balance evidence changes
failure_pattern_risk: Confidence Debt (Core): price used in models before any buyer evidence
edf_applicability: Not applicable to the assumption itself (EDF-02 requires a factual observed outcome; this is a hypothesis about a business that does not exist).
edf_adjacent_observed_outcome: Observed: RCF paid Ren $19.2255m in FY2024 under a ~98%-of-fees arrangement (EDF-1 candidate: why is the servicer fee set as a share of sponsor fees?)

assumption_statement: A five-person fixed core (MD/sales, technical lead, engineer, controller, grant/client operations) can run the servicer.
admissibility_result: Admissible; budget itself says '5 FTE is a hypothesis' and forbids one controller approving own work.
operational_test: Fails under pressure: one absence breaks dual authorisation; December peak lowers exception SLA attainment to ~0.70 at base staffing (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:62).
supporting_evidence: Unbound staffed offer modelled with a 4-FTE team floor for ~5,000-fund sponsors (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:90-92, assumption); affiliate-staffed models reach 5,670 grants per employee (daf-landscape:research/ai-native-daf-enterprise/09-financial-models/financial-and-staffing-models.md, observed ratio, different staffing model); tail community foundation median opex $630k with 5 staff (daf-landscape:research/commercial-opportunity/clarity-edf-analysis/assumption-tests.md:100).
contradictory_evidence: Prior AI-native model needs 24 FTE at 1,000 accounts incl. 5 leadership, 4 engineering, 7 agent ownership/evaluation, 1 security (daf-landscape:research/ai-native-daf-enterprise/09-financial-models/financial-and-staffing-models.md:179-200 governing update, [A]); budget's own $40/account labour implies ~2.5 additional FTE at 5,000 funds (daf-landscape:research/commercial-opportunity/daf-servicer-bottom-up-operating-budget-2026-11-25.md 'Incremental cost and capacity'); observed accounts per FTE 62.7 (NPT), 107 (AEF), 232 (Vanguard) (daf-landscape:research/ai-native-daf-enterprise/09-financial-models/financial-and-staffing-models.md §2).
evidence_admissibility_notes: Both supporting and contradicting staffing figures are model assumptions from the same research programme (not independent); observed ratios come from different operating models.
hidden_assumptions: A working platform already exists and two engineers maintain it; the sponsor performs all reserved decisions (decision cost ~$42-43/fund transferred to sponsor, daf-servicing-20bps-market-entry-2026-11-25.md:24); no 24x7 on-call; MD covers sales, compliance oversight and incident command; founders' unpaid time not counted.
causal_mechanism: Automation plus sponsor-retained decisions reduce servicer touches; accountability roles (approval, SoD, incident response) are fixed floors not reduced by automation.
alternative_explanations: Leanness is produced by moving cost to the sponsor (decision teams) and to Echelon/owner (engineering), not by efficiency.
incentives: Founder incentive to understate fixed cost to reach break-even; sponsor's auditor needs SoD evidence; staff burnout incentives in peak.
feedback_loops: Under-capacity -> backlog -> missed SLAs -> sponsor escalations and donor contacts -> more load (reinforcing); key-person loss -> control failure.
dependencies: AC-04 automation; AC-05 shared infrastructure; sponsor delegations (up to eight sponsor-side authorisations, unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:60 EV-08).
failure_conditions: Any single vacancy stops dual approval; exception volume exceeds capacity in December; service auditor finds SoD deficiencies.
counterfactuals: 8-FTE core (+3 x ~$150k loaded [A]); outsourced operations partner; founder-led with contracted controller.
falsifying_evidence: 90-day time study showing >48 minutes per account-year; SoD design that cannot be met with five named roles; observed post-reuse exception rate above 8%.
correctability: Moderately correctable (hiring) but control failures are low correctability
monitoring_signal: Exceptions queue age; hours per account-year; dual-approval coverage
threshold: Queue age > SLA (5 business days) for >5% of items; coverage gap any day
trigger_claim: Coverage gaps imply control failure, not just delay
trigger_reassessment: Re-examine if automation or sponsor delegations change workload
edf_applicability: Not applicable to the assumption itself (EDF-02 requires a factual observed outcome; this is a hypothesis about a business that does not exist).
edf_adjacent_observed_outcome: Observed: national sponsors report 0 employees because affiliates do the work (14-PUBLIC-DATA-REPLAY.md:27) - EDF-0 candidate on where staffing cost sits

assumption_statement: Incremental cost is about $75 per fund-year above the fixed budget.
admissibility_result: Flag: 'False precision or tidy-but-unearned models' - a single per-account number decomposed without activity drivers; budget calls it a placeholder.
operational_test: Fails for accounts with many grants or complex assets; survives only at low activity mix.
supporting_evidence: AI inference <=$1 per fund (05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:61 EV-09); infra per account $3 (0.5-6) [A] with benchmark capacity 2,100-3,900 tx/s vs ~200 needed (unbound:requirements/discovery/2026-11-24-simplification-economics/model/parameters.json; unbound:requirements/discovery/2026-11-23-cross-industry/18-ARCHITECTURE-BENCHMARK.md).
contradictory_evidence: Unbound staffed-offer cost $192/$298 per fund at 10k funds (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:96) - all-in, not incremental, so not directly comparable; minutes per exception 45 (30-135) [A] (unbound:requirements/discovery/2026-11-24-simplification-economics/model/parameters.json); raw routed rows 11.2% vs 8% base (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/14-PUBLIC-DATA-REPLAY.md:36); sensitivity: grants per account 31.8%, exception rate 27.6% (daf-landscape:research/ai-native-daf-enterprise/09-financial-models/financial-and-staffing-models.md §4).
evidence_admissibility_notes: No measured handling time exists anywhere (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/14-PUBLIC-DATA-REPLAY.md:28); every component is an assumption.
hidden_assumptions: Anchor's grants per account and contacts resemble the model; ACH default; few reconciliation breaks; per-account rather than per-grant drivers.
causal_mechanism: Variable cost = labour minutes x loaded rate + per-transaction vendor fees; driven by grants, contributions, contacts, exceptions, not by account count.
alternative_explanations: Per-account cost is a proxy for activity; two sponsors with equal accounts can differ several-fold in cost per account (cost per grant $55-$419, {AT}:65).
incentives: Payment vendors price per transaction; sponsors may keep cheques; donors with small balances generate same contacts.
feedback_loops: Low-balance accounts cost the same as high-balance ones under bps pricing -> unprofitable tail grows if onboarding is indiscriminate.
dependencies: AC-04; payment rail mix (electronic rails reach ~15-25% of charities by count, unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/13-EVIDENCE-BACKLOG-RESULTS.md:43); AC-07.
failure_conditions: Measured incremental cost >$150 per account at anchor mix; v/B >= r when B <= $37,500 at $75 [D: 75/0.002].
counterfactuals: Activity-based costing per grant/contribution/exception; per-transaction pass-through pricing.
falsifying_evidence: Shadow replay + 90-day time study (Unbound report 12) exceeding 48 labour minutes per account-year; published payment-vendor price lists above $10 per account-year at anchor activity.
correctability: Highly correctable via repricing before contract; moderate after
monitoring_signal: Labour minutes and vendor fees per account per month
threshold: >$100 per account-year annualised for two consecutive months
trigger_claim: Above $100 the break-even AUA at B=$200k rises materially
trigger_reassessment: When activity drivers replace per-account placeholder
edf_applicability: Not applicable to the assumption itself (EDF-02 requires a factual observed outcome; this is a hypothesis about a business that does not exist).
edf_adjacent_observed_outcome: Observed: cost per grant ranges $55 (DAFgiving360) to $419 (NPT) ({AT}:65) - EDF-1 candidate on what drives unit cost

assumption_statement: Automation (deterministic eligibility rules, determination reuse, AI flagging) keeps human handling low enough for lean staffing.
working_value: Effective first-time eligibility exceptions ~4% (C) / 3.2% (D); overall handling levers unmeasured
admissibility_result: Admissible if bounded to the eligibility component; unbounded 'automation' claims fail Bounded Truth.
operational_test: Survives for eligibility reuse on public data; untested for contacts, reconciliation and purpose/benefit exceptions.
supporting_evidence: Public replay: 151,567 recipient rows; effective first-time exception incidence 4.0% within sponsor, 3.1% platform; reuse 64.4% (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/14-PUBLIC-DATA-REPLAY.md:36-39); safety 600/600 bad cases routed correctly (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/14-PUBLIC-DATA-REPLAY.md:46).
contradictory_evidence: Raw rows routed to a person 11.2%/12.8% (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/14-PUBLIC-DATA-REPLAY.md:36), above the 8% base; reference sanctions matcher missed 12 of 100 perturbed listed names (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/14-PUBLIC-DATA-REPLAY.md:47); handling minutes, contacts, non-eligibility exceptions not measurable (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/14-PUBLIC-DATA-REPLAY.md:28); without levers C0 ~ B (05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:54 EV-02); levers apply only after up to eight sponsor authorisations (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:60 EV-08).
evidence_admissibility_notes: Replay is measured but uses Schedule I recipient rows (>$5k), not grant counts; covers only 20 sponsors; one deterministic tool by the same programme.
hidden_assumptions: Sponsors and auditors accept deterministic clearance; recipient-level results transfer to grant-level work; AI adds flags but never clears; data feeds current (revocation posting lag median 89 days, unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/14-PUBLIC-DATA-REPLAY.md:42).
causal_mechanism: Recipients recur, so a verified determination can be reused; deterministic rules clear standard cases; humans handle the residual.
alternative_explanations: Large sponsors in the sample have repeat recipients that small/new sponsors lack; incumbents can adopt the same reuse policy (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:54).
incentives: Servicer cost incentive to raise straight-through rate vs sponsor's §4966/4967 liability; screening safety must not be traded for cost.
feedback_loops: Platform reuse improves with scale (reinforcing); a missed sanctions match -> incident -> tighter rules -> lower automation (balancing).
dependencies: Sponsor delegations; auditor acceptance; feed quality; AC-08 legal boundary.
failure_conditions: Sponsor requires per-grant sign-off; post-reuse exception rate >8% at anchor; any production sanctions miss.
counterfactuals: B (AI-enhanced incumbent workflow): E1 $251 vs C $189 per fund-year after OD-M-09 (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:78).
falsifying_evidence: Real sponsor 12-month shadow replay and 90-day time study (CNV-ECO-003 gate); sanctions recall suite below agreed threshold.
claim_state: suggestive (eligibility component, public data); unsupported (overall handling)
correctability: Low for screening misses; moderate for cost
monitoring_signal: Post-reuse exception rate; sanctions recall on seeded tests; human touches per 1,000 funds
trigger_claim: Recall below 100% on seeds means real misses are possible
trigger_reassessment: When list formats or matcher change
edf_applicability: Not applicable to the assumption itself (EDF-02 requires a factual observed outcome; this is a hypothesis about a business that does not exist). The replay results are an observed outcome and could be EDF-diagnosed.
edf_adjacent_observed_outcome: Observed: 12 of 100 perturbed listed names passed the reference matcher (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/14-PUBLIC-DATA-REPLAY.md:47) - EDF-1 candidate

assumption_statement: Shared Echelon infrastructure lowers the servicer's engineering, platform and administration cost.
working_value: Implicit in 2 engineering FTE, $36k cloud, $18k software
admissibility_result: Flag: 'Cleverness without reuse'/'hero narrative' risk if a single maintainer's ecosystem is presented as an enterprise platform.
operational_test: Fails if the single maintainer is unavailable or the licence is not granted.
supporting_evidence: Vendored Forma 1.0.2 and Folio 0.4.2 (unbound:requirements/ui/designs/vendor/); EEF F# code with 87 test attributes; Unbound requirements baseline 316/316 questions, 82/82 clauses; PostgreSQL benchmark (see echelon-capabilities.csv ECH-03/05/07/09/17).
contradictory_evidence: No application code (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/LEDGER.md:4; CHARTER principle 8); no production deployment by anyone other than the author (daf-landscape:research/ai-native-daf-enterprise/07-technology-architecture/echelon-component-assessment.md §1 obs.4); PolyForm NC on nearly all components (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/07-ECHELON-CAPABILITY-ASSESSMENT.md:24); identity, embed runtime, PDF production, provider virtualisation are Unbound-owned work (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/07-ECHELON-CAPABILITY-ASSESSMENT.md:162-164); Aegis is not security, Fides GitHub-only (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/07-ECHELON-CAPABILITY-ASSESSMENT.md:122-124).
evidence_admissibility_notes: Component assessments are read-only inspections by agents of the same programme; no builds or tests were run (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/07-ECHELON-CAPABILITY-ASSESSMENT.md:8).
hidden_assumptions: Echelon time is not charged to the DAF P&L; components stay maintained; licence granted cheaply; servicer and Unbound are the same entity.
causal_mechanism: Reuse amortises build across products; only true if the reused part is large relative to the DAF-specific build.
alternative_explanations: Apparent low cost is unpriced founder/Echelon labour (transfer).
incentives: Unbound is also an 'EF capability experiment' (PRINCIPLES.md:19), which rewards using Echelon components even where commodity services are cheaper.
feedback_loops: DAF demand funds Echelon improvements (reinforcing) vs upstream churn breaks DAF builds (Praxis 11 releases in ~2 weeks; Forma namespace rename).
dependencies: Licence; maintainer availability; ECH rows in echelon-capabilities.csv.
failure_conditions: Maintainer unavailable >30 days; licence refused or priced above commodity; independent security review fails.
counterfactuals: Commodity stack: managed IdP, PDF service, OpenTelemetry vendor, plain CSS; conventional team of 4-10 engineers (financial-and-staffing-models.md §3, [A]).
falsifying_evidence: Intercompany cost study showing Echelon-provided capabilities cost >= commodity equivalents; exit-cost estimate > savings.
correctability: Low once platform built on components
monitoring_signal: Echelon hours charged; upstream breaking changes per quarter; licence status
threshold: Any uncharged hours; >1 breaking change per quarter
trigger_claim: Uncharged hours mean the P&L understates cost
edf_applicability: Not applicable to the assumption itself (EDF-02 requires a factual observed outcome; this is a hypothesis about a business that does not exist).
edf_adjacent_observed_outcome: Observed: registry channel, tags and Unbound vendor copies disagree on versions (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/07-ECHELON-CAPABILITY-ASSESSMENT.md:10-24) - EDF-0 candidate
recommended_commitment: Delay dependency commitment; Continue Experiment for UI/print

assumption_statement: An anchor sponsor (~$1B AUA) can be acquired within the funding runway.
admissibility_result: Flag: 'prescription without a signal' unless tied to a dated trigger (renewal, merger, conversion).
operational_test: Fails if the sponsor's board weighs startup operational risk over price.
supporting_evidence: Sponsors of the needed size exist: JCF $3.405B/5,061 funds, Raymond James $2.325B/11,262 (FY2025 EOY, research/commercial-opportunity/daf-servicing-20bps-market-entry-2026-11-25.md table; data/mission-2026-11-14/daf-sponsor-league-table-fy2025-refresh.csv); Ren's named 990 receipts 85.8% from three customers - single sponsors can carry a servicer (research/commercial-opportunity/clarity-edf-analysis/assumption-tests.md:72); platform conversions create dated windows (LPL-Commonwealth, research/commercial-opportunity/clarity-edf-analysis/assumption-tests.md:137).
contradictory_evidence: No public RFPs for DAF administration 2024-26 (research/commercial-opportunity/clarity-edf-analysis/assumption-tests.md:148); migrations freeze grants ~3-5 weeks and lose history (research/commercial-opportunity/clarity-edf-analysis/assumption-tests.md:114); only 20 US sponsors hold >=5,000 accounts (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:14-16); low switching pressure (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/05-ECONOMIC-VALIDATION.md:59); sales cycles unknown (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/13-EVIDENCE-BACKLOG-RESULTS.md:55); no interviews completed (research/commercial-opportunity/clarity-edf-analysis/assumption-tests.md:119).
evidence_admissibility_notes: League-table figures are year-end filings (not average billable); no buyer-intent evidence of any kind.
hidden_assumptions: Anchor converts its full book; startup accepted without SOC 1 history; anchor not affiliated with an incumbent; onboarding fits runway.
causal_mechanism: Switching occurs at dated triggers when incumbent cost/risk exceeds migration risk.
alternative_explanations: Sponsors switch mainly when parents mandate or incumbents fail, not on price.
incentives: Sponsor staff displaced by outsourcing resist; boards avoid migration risk; incumbents price-match.
feedback_loops: First anchor -> reference -> next sale (reinforcing); anchor concentration -> bargaining power -> price compression.
dependencies: AC-01; SOC report; insurance; capital runway (budget: $1.428m-$2.606m for 12-24 months).
failure_conditions: No signed anchor within 18 months; anchor >50% of revenue churns at first renewal.
counterfactuals: Subcontract to an incumbent; software-only; partner with a sponsor-of-record.
falsifying_evidence: Zero qualified sponsors with a dated trigger among 15-20 discovery interviews.
threshold: <3 qualified sponsors with triggers within 6 months
trigger_claim: Without dated triggers, sales cycle exceeds runway
trigger_reassessment: When a pilot contract is signed
edf_applicability: Not applicable to the assumption itself (EDF-02 requires a factual observed outcome; this is a hypothesis about a business that does not exist).
edf_adjacent_observed_outcome: Observed: no public market for independent DAF assessment (already EDF-1 diagnosed in assumption-tests.md §2 C1)

assumption_statement: Average billable balance per account is high enough (~$200k) that bps revenue exceeds per-account cost.
admissibility_result: Flag: mean used without distribution (false precision).
operational_test: Fails under market shock (30% asset fall) and for sponsors with many small funds.
supporting_evidence: FY2025 EOY assets per account among top-50 sponsors with 1k-20k accounts: median ~$406k, p25 ~$206k, p75 ~$673k (n=9) [D from data/mission-2026-11-14/daf-sponsor-league-table-fy2025-refresh.csv].
contradictory_evidence: Year-end is not average billable; grants/EOY assets median ~0.20 in the same n=9 [D]; payout 25.4% three-year average, 21.9% in 2022 (research/mission-2026-11-14/owner-refetch-citation-recheck-2026-11-20.md:67); micro-account processors distort means (Givinga $1.37 EOY per account, research/mission-2026-11-14/queue-batch38-data-followups.md:60); minimum average balance $96k-$150k for break-even at Unbound's cost (research/commercial-opportunity/daf-servicing-20bps-market-entry-2026-11-25.md:24).
evidence_admissibility_notes: EOY Schedule D figures are primary filings (quality A for the number, B for this use).
hidden_assumptions: Billable base excludes cash in transit; tiers not applied; mean equals typical anchor account; balances stable within year.
causal_mechanism: Revenue = r x average AUA; cost ~ v x accounts; margin depends on B (break-even AUA = F/(r - v/B)).
alternative_explanations: High means are driven by few very large funds that negotiate lower rates.
incentives: Servicer incentive to keep assets in funds conflicts with grant-making.
feedback_loops: Downturn lowers balances while grant requests and contacts may rise.
failure_conditions: Average billable below ~$96k-$150k at Unbound's modelled cost; at $75 variable cost, B <= $37.5k makes v/B >= r [D].
counterfactuals: Per-fund fee; tiered bps with minimum per account.
falsifying_evidence: Anchor's monthly average balance distribution (not EOY mean).
monitoring_signal: Monthly average billable AUA per account
trigger_claim: Below $150k margins vanish at modelled cost
trigger_reassessment: When actual cost per account is measured
edf_applicability: Not applicable to the assumption itself (EDF-02 requires a factual observed outcome; this is a hypothesis about a business that does not exist).
edf_adjacent_observed_outcome: Observed: AOGF moved ~710k micro accounts out of the DAF column (DAF-INDUSTRY-REPORT-2026-11.md:742) - EDF-0 candidate on denominators

assumption_statement: The servicer stays outside custody, advice and fundraising regulation: sponsor keeps ownership and reserved decisions; servicer relays sponsor-authorised instructions only.
working_value: No custody; no unilateral payment control; no advice
admissibility_result: Admissible as a design rule; as a legal conclusion it is a hypothesis pending counsel (CHARTER).
operational_test: Fails under sponsor pressure to take on decisions or advice (scope creep).
supporting_evidence: CNV-LEG-001 regulatory perimeter (unbound:requirements/AUTHORITATIVE-BASELINE.md:70) and its 'execute' definition (clauses/c10_round2_amendments.py); commercial co-venturer/solicitor regimes do not reach a flat-fee non-soliciting platform in 47 states (13-EVIDENCE-BACKLOG-RESULTS.md:12, interpretation).
contradictory_evidence: California and Hawaii platform rules cover SaaS/white-label platforms and sponsor exclusions protect the sponsor, not the vendor (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/13-EVIDENCE-BACKLOG-RESULTS.md:11); fundraising-counsel registration in ~25 jurisdictions if advising (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/13-EVIDENCE-BACKLOG-RESULTS.md:13); NY/GA uncertain, 35 rows from an unverified secondary chart (unbound:requirements/convergence/2026-11-24-master/13-EVIDENCE-BACKLOG-RESULTS.md:11,15); §4966/4967 manager knowing-agreement exposure (daf-landscape:research/commercial-opportunity/clarity-edf-analysis/assumption-tests.md:37); money-transmission treatment of payment relay not researched in the sources read (unknown).
evidence_admissibility_notes: No counsel opinion; statute text read for 15 states only.
hidden_assumptions: Servicer never holds funds even transiently; sponsor delegation instruments exist; reports contain no investment advice; bps fee does not make the servicer a solicitor.
causal_mechanism: Perimeter determines licences, insurance, capital and staffing.
alternative_explanations: Perimeter erodes through product creep (donor messaging, grant suggestions).
incentives: Sponsors push work and liability onto servicer; servicer wants scope to grow revenue.
feedback_loops: Incident -> regulator attention -> new registration duties.
failure_conditions: Counsel finds registration/licensing needed; sponsor demands indemnities beyond insurance.
counterfactuals: Become a sponsor (full fiduciary role) or software-only vendor.
falsifying_evidence: Counsel opinion; state regulator guidance; payment-partner onboarding requirements.

assumption_statement: Sponsor contracts will carry minimum annual fees (or minimum AUA commitments) that cover fixed cost during ramp and downturns.
working_value: Not set; budget notes 'Sponsor concentration and minimum contract fee matter'
admissibility_result: Admissible; currently a prescription without a signal (no buyer evidence).
operational_test: Fails if buyers refuse fixed commitments from a startup vendor.
supporting_evidence: Vendor contracts are described as setting 'price and minimum volume' (research/daf-economics-and-distribution-2026-11-11.md:26, no figures); donor-level minimums exist ($250 RCF, $100 Fidelity) (same file:64-66) - donor-facing, NOT servicer revenue; RCF administrator revenue-share of $5 a quarter on minimum-fee accounts (research/mission-2026-11-14/queue-batch31-fees-costs.md:113).
contradictory_evidence: No public servicer contract with a minimum fee found; Ren programme fees opaque (daf-landscape:research/daf-economics-and-distribution-2026-11-11.md:26 [E15]); contract terms still unknown (13-EVIDENCE-BACKLOG-RESULTS.md:53).
evidence_admissibility_notes: Evidence is indirect; donor minimums must not be read as servicer terms.
hidden_assumptions: Minimum enforceable when assets fall; sponsor accepts minimum above bps run-rate in ramp.
causal_mechanism: Minimum transfers ramp and market risk from servicer to sponsor.
alternative_explanations: Implementation fees or term commitments achieve the same; minimums may be negotiated away for anchors.
incentives: Sponsor resists fixed cost; may pass to donors via fees (Burden Externalization if passed to funds).
feedback_loops: Minimum reduces revenue volatility but lengthens sales cycle.
failure_conditions: Anchor refuses minimum; minimum triggers donor fee increases.
counterfactuals: Pure bps; per-fund fee; setup fee.
falsifying_evidence: Buyer interviews and any obtainable contract templates.
threshold: Minimum < fixed cost share allocated to that sponsor
trigger_claim: Without minimums downturn loss falls on servicer
edf_applicability: Not applicable to the assumption itself (EDF-02 requires a factual observed outcome; this is a hypothesis about a business that does not exist).
